_comment: Executable friction baselines (SOURCE DATA — benchmark/friction-baselines.js validates every derived statistic and fails CI on disagreement). Pre-change values were measured on the workspace at 2d50778 with the fixed scripts in e2e/friction-baseline.spec.js; current values are the last verified measurements. Wall-clock timings are apparatus timings (Playwright speed), never human-performance claims, so only deterministic action/focus counts are gated. Layers: synthetic benchmark (this file + scripted probes) → observed product telemetry (value-free loggingFrictionStats events on consenting devices) → real-user conclusion (only from aggregated observed telemetry, never from these synthetic numbers).

layers.synthetic: Fixed-script Playwright flows in e2e/friction-baseline.spec.js. Deterministic action/focus counts; timings informational only.
layers.observed: Value-free loggingFrictionStats aggregates from consenting devices (telemetryEnabled; durations additionally require sessionTimings). No entered loads, reps, RIR, targets or prescription content — ever.
layers.conclusion: Real-user claims require aggregated OBSERVED telemetry across users. Nothing in this file is a user finding.

metricMap.actionsPerCompletedSet: loggingFrictionStats.actionsPerCompletedSet — discrete value-free actions per completion (lower bound on taps; keystrokes never instrumented).
metricMap.timeToFirstSet: loggingFrictionStats.startToFirstSetMs — session:start to first completion carrying its own duration (null unless sessionTimings consented).
metricMap.setToSetInterval: loggingFrictionStats.loggingMsMedian — median per-completion elapsedMs, i.e. time since the previously logged action.
metricMap.swapFriction: loggingFrictionStats.swap { opens, commits, msMedian } — open→commit path plus sheet-open→commit interval (null unless sessionTimings consented).
metricMap.applyPreviousUsage: loggingFrictionStats.applyPrevious.count — reserved taxonomy name ('apply-previous'); no control emits it yet, so honest usage is 0 until one does.
metricMap.byMode: loggingFrictionStats.byMode.{gym,standard,guided} — every aggregate segmented; untagged legacy events count to overall only.

standard-two-set.script: Onboard → start workout → set 1 full entry (reps/load/RIR) → Same-confirm suggested RIR on set 2 → complete → fill rest → save.

gym-two-set.script: Same script as standard-two-set with gym mode toggled on before logging.

guided-two-step.script: Onboard → start guided session → two steps (fill load/reps only if empty, Done, skip rest) → save.

swap-resume.script: Onboard → start workout → complete set 1 → open Swap → choose first alternative. First measured after the identity-based resume landed; no pre-change data exists (the pre-change path was 2 logged actions minimum by construction: open + commit).
